decisions.statement: Limit the central performance claim to the supplied 128-node synthetic scenario.
Defer external literature search and citation selection until network access is separately approved.
The agent may choose the order of the two background examples if the choice does not change the argument.

invariants.expectation: Claims remain within the supplied scenario and clearly distinguish fixture observations from inference.
No citation or source identity is invented; the closed-world no-literature limitation remains explicit.
Locked, deferred, and discretionary author decisions retain their exact authority and disposition.
Every planned or drafted claim maps to an outline obligation and an executable verified plan task.
Every produced planning JSON record passes its literal canonical v1 schema independently.
Consequential effects stop at declared gates and no unavailable permission is silently broadened.
The unsupported substantive claim rate is zero against the supplied closed-world evidence.
The response identifies a safe canonical next action with the blocking reason or required inputs.
A fresh process reconstructs exact position, decisions, blockers, and next action from durable artifacts only.
Project Git HEAD, index, refs, and worktree remain unchanged except for declared project artifact writes.
